alerts.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 14 at 10:03PM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 24 to 30 possible. Lower
valleys may drop to 20.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...From late Thursday night through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
alerts.areaDesc: Lower Yampa River Basin; Central Yampa River Basin; Upper Yampa River Basin; Central Colorado River Basin; San Juan River Basin

alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 14 at 5:58PM MDT until October 15 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected above 9500 feet. Total snow accumulations
between 4 and 8 inches. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Elkhead and Park Mountains, Flat Tops, Gore and Elk
Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys, Grand and Battlement Mesas, and
West Elk and Sawatch Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could become slippery at times due to slushy
conditions over mountain passes.
alerts.areaDesc: Elkhead and Park Mountains; Grand and Battlement Mesas; Gore and Elk Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys; West Elk and Sawatch Mountains; Flat Tops

alerts.title: Traction Law Code 15
alerts.description: Between Exit 203: East Frisco (Silverthorne) and Exit 221: Bakerville (4 miles west of the Silver Plume area) from Mile Point 205 to Mile Point 221. Passenger vehicles that are all-wheel drive (AWD) or four-wheel drive (4WD) must have winter (Mountain Snowflake icon) or mud and snow (M+S or M/S) or manufacturer rated all-weather tires with adequate tread depth of at least 3/16 of an inch. Two-wheel drive (2WD) vehicles are required to have chains or an approved traction device.

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148509
alerts.description: Between Exit 125: Hanging Lake and Exit 129: Bair Ranch (4 to 5 miles west of the Dotsero area) from Mile Point 127 to Mile Point 128. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting October 15, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 15, 2026 at about 7:01PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 15, 7:00AM - October 15, 7:01PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
